sources.title: AI Kill Switch Act introduced after OpenAI rogue model incident
sources.snippet: The AI Kill Switch Act would require developers of the most powerful AI systems to maintain shutdown capabilities, with civil penalties up to $20 million per day for noncompliance

sources.title: How to Fix the AI Model Theft Bill Before It Becomes Law
sources.snippet: Adversarial AI distillation poses a growing threat to U.S. AI leadership and national security, and Congress is right to address it through the Deterring American AI Model Theft Act (DAAMTA).
